title: domains.check submission manifest

app.name: Domain Availability
app.shortDescription: Check if a domain name is available right now.
app.longDescription: Use when you need to know whether a domain name can be registered today. Checks live registry state (not guesses), returns availability plus current registration and renewal prices. Also searches for available names from a business idea, compares prices across registrars, and scores names for length and clarity.

positive: Give me name ideas for acme widgets

releaseNotes: Initial ChatGPT plugin surface for domains.check. Remote MCP endpoint required for submission.
